opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be supported by a Society Representative or a Fellow. Funding cannot be used to support salary costs, to attend conferences or to fund membership payments.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to support Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation, including internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars or outreach events.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to postdoctoral researchers who require additional support to help them achieve their full potential. Funds cannot be used to pay for staff salaries but may be used for consumables, registration for Higher Education Academy Fellowship or other sundries.
opportunities.summary: Provides support to postdoctoral researchers to help them achieve their full potential, in memory of Professor Hisako Ikeda-Wolstencroft. Funds should be used within 12 months of receipt.

opportunities.title: Education and Teaching Award

deadlines.raw: Applications for 2026 are now closed. Applications will reopen in autumn 2026.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: The applicant's host institution must be willing to administer the award. Funding cannot be used to buy out teaching time, support salary costs or attend conferences.
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct a piece of publishable educational research that addresses a key question in physiological education.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award

deadlines.raw: Applications for 2026 are now closed. Applications will reopen in autumn 2026.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications should be physiological in nature. The applicant's host institution must be willing to administer the award. Funding cannot be used to support salary costs or to attend conferences.
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to conduct pilot studies, develop a new technique or finalise a project, as well as supporting activities to promote knowledge transfer and impact.

opportunities.title: Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Fund

deadlines.raw: Applications have closed for 2026. They will reopen in 2027.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full members or Fellows of the Physiological Society in their second year of membership or longer. Funding cannot be used to support salary costs or to attend conferences.
opportunities.summary: Provides support for Members to run activities that address the principles of Equity, Diversity and Inclusion in the physiological sciences, in either teaching or research.

opportunities.title: Conference Attendance Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to members of the Society. Postgraduate, Full and Fellow member applicants must be submitting/presenting an abstract at the meeting they wish to attend. Awards can only be used to attend Society meetings and Society-sponsored meetings.
opportunities.summary: Supports member engagement at the Society's own meetings and, where funding allows, attendance at Society-sponsored events. Covers registration and a contribution toward travel and accommodation.
